bundle.longDescription: An independent launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition. It installs releases with or without Forge, NeoForge, Fabric or Quilt and the Java each needs, signs in with a Microsoft account or starts the demo, and keeps backups of worlds. Not an official Minecraft product; not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
